notes.title: Ducky Clicker Release!
notes.content:
Ducky Clicker is launching on Steam on February 3rd! 🦆🎉

The wait is over! Get ready to click your way into the most fun and addictive rubber duck experience. 🐤💛

🛠️ Build your duck empire: From classic ducks to quantum ones, there’s a duck for everyone!
🚀 Uncover secrets: Explore wacky dimensions, unlock cosmic mysteries, and conquer the Void.
🎨 Unique customization: Create your own duck universe and make it yours.
🎶 Relaxing tunes: Chill out while you rule your rubber duck kingdom.
📅 Mark your calendars!
🛒 Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist to stay updated.
